text: England can reach the Nations Championship final by beating New Zealand, with Borthwick picking his first-choice XV and Fin Smith back at fly-half.
Gerwyn Price survived two match darts to beat Niko Springer 16-15 at the Grand Slam of Darts and now faces Kevin Doets in the semi-finals.
Wakamotoharu beat Aonishiki on day 14 to stay in the Kyushu sumo title race, with Onosato and Atamifuji also alive going into Sunday's final day.
The Grand Slam of Curling National in Sydney, Nova Scotia reaches its playoffs on Saturday with the finals on Sunday, and Rachel Homan, who has four titles there, opened with a win.
The Washington Spirit and Kansas City Current meet in the NWSL Championship tonight at 8:00 PM New York time at Audi Field, on CBS and Paramount+.
The 2-8 Jets, who have lost five straight and not scored a touchdown in two games, visit the 1-8 Chargers on Sunday with Geno Smith expected to start if healthy.
